lunch_start_2.name: {name}
lunch_start_2.text: *I step out of the classroom and the hallway is packed with students. No idea where to go. Cafeteria? Snack bar? Or —*

lunch_start_3.name: {name}
lunch_start_3.text: *Signals come from three directions at once.*

lunch_start_4.name: {name}
lunch_start_4.text: *At the end of the hallway, Seoyeon catches my eye and gestures. Pointing toward the rooftop.*

lunch_start_5.name: Dain
lunch_start_5.text: Hey! Have you eaten?! Let's hit the snack bar! I'll buy you bread... loser pays!

lunch_start_6.name: {name}
lunch_start_6.text: *And Yuna slips out of the classroom with just her bag. Heading toward the library.*

lunch_start_7.name: {name}
lunch_start_7.text: *Three paths. A choice like this on day one.*

lunch_start_7b.name: {name}
lunch_start_7b.text: *At my old school, I never chose. To be precise, I kept putting it off until the moment passed. — There it is again. My mouth moves smooth enough, but when it actually matters, it locks up. This pattern. I'm my own worst disappointment.*

lunch_choice.name: {name}
choices: Go to the snack bar with Dain

lunch_seo_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon unlocks the rooftop door with her key. A gust of wind rushes in.*

lunch_seo_2.name: {name}
lunch_seo_2.text: *The rooftop is clean. A few potted plants and a folding chair on one side. Someone's been maintaining this.*

lunch_seo_4.name: {name}
lunch_seo_4.text: A rooftop reserved for the council president?

lunch_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_5.text: I don't just bring anyone up here. *unfolds a chair* Today's special.

lunch_seo_6.name: {name}
lunch_seo_6.text: Special treatment on day one? Sounds suspicious.

lunch_seo_7.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_7.text: You're paranoid. The classroom air was just stuffy, that's all.

lunch_seo_8.name: {name}
lunch_seo_8.text: *Seoyeon pulls out a lunchbox from her bag. Neatly packed for two.*

lunch_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_10.text: I already confirmed you're sharp, remember?

lunch_seo_11.name: {name}
lunch_seo_11.text: *She planned to eat together from the start. — But she'd never say it that way.*

lunch_seo_12.name: {name}
lunch_seo_12.text: *She opens the lunchbox. Carefully prepared side dishes. Rolled eggs, sausages, mini rice balls.*

lunch_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_14.text: A council president has to be good at everything.

lunch_seo_16.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_16.text: *hands over chopsticks* Eat. It's no good cold.

lunch_seo_17.name: {name}
lunch_seo_17.text: *She's skilled at dodging questions. Whether it's practiced or natural.*

lunch_seo_18.name: {name}
lunch_seo_18.text: *We eat for a while. The breeze is nice. The school grounds from the rooftop — wider than I expected.*

lunch_seo_21.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_21.text: *smirks* I asked about the school, and you answer about the food.

lunch_seo_22.name: {name}
lunch_seo_22.text: *Seoyeon picks up a piece of rolled egg and holds it out.*

lunch_seo_choice.name: {name}
lunch_seo_choice.text: *Seoyeon is holding out the rolled egg.*
choices: It'd taste better if you ate it yourself

lunch_seo_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_1.text: *I take the rolled egg from Seoyeon's chopsticks.*

lunch_seo_c1_4.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_4.text: *Seoyeon clears her throat and subtly looks away. Her hand reaches for the back of her neck — the gesture looks a little awkward.*

lunch_seo_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c2_1.text: *Seoyeon puts the rolled egg in her own mouth. Chewing slowly.*

lunch_seo_c2_3.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c2_3.text: *She's playing it cool, but she seems slightly miffed.*

lunch_seo_after_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_2.text: Want to come again next time?

lunch_seo_after_5.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_5.text: *That's so Seoyeon. Not an invitation, a permission. — But why is she smiling?*

lunch_seo_after_6.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_6.text: *Seoyeon packs up the lunchbox and brushes her hair back with her pinky. An unconscious habit, it seems.*

lunch_seo_after_7.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_7.text: *Her pinky finger. — A tiny detail, but it sticks with me.*

lunch_dain_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1.text: Oh! You came! I saw you during introductions! Let's eat together!

lunch_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch_dain_2.text: Here we go! What do you want?! My pick is the crumble bread and strawberry milk!

lunch_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch_dain_3.text: But you said loser pays. What are we doing?

lunch_dain_13.name: Dain
lunch_dain_13.text: Ugh, fine! I'm buying, I'm buying! Ma'am, two crumble breads please!

lunch_dain_14.name: {name}
lunch_dain_14.text: *Dain grumbles while buying the bread. But the corners of her mouth are turned up.*

lunch_dain_15.name: {name}
lunch_dain_15.text: *We sit on a bench by the snack bar and eat our bread.*

lunch_dain_16.name: Dain
lunch_dain_16.text: *tearing into bread* Hey, do you seriously not do sports?

lunch_dain_18.name: Dain
lunch_dain_18.text: No, it's just that keeping up with me takes some stamina! Haha

lunch_dain_21.name: {name}
lunch_dain_21.text: Personal Record. It's a sports term.

lunch_dain_23.name: Dain
lunch_dain_23.text: Oh, you know that?! You DO know sports, don't you?!

lunch_dain_choice.name: {name}
lunch_dain_choice.text: *Dain is staring at me with expectant eyes.*
choices: A little. Would you teach me?

lunch_dain_c1_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c1_1.text: Haha, awesome!! I'll teach you everything! Gym after school, deal?!

lunch_dain_c1_2.name: {name}
lunch_dain_c1_2.text: *Her eyes become half-moons. So that's what she looks like when she smiles. — A detail I'd have missed if I hadn't been watching.*

lunch_dain_c2_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c2_1.text: Aw come on, you're still interested though! Come to the gym after school! You won't regret it!

lunch_dain_after.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after.text: *We finish the bread and stand up.*

lunch_dain_after_4.name: Dain
lunch_dain_after_4.text: I'm the first person you had a meal with at your new school, right? Remember that!

lunch_dain_after_5.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after_5.text: *She grins and punches my shoulder lightly.*

lunch_dain_after_6.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after_6.text: *I don't know why I should remember that, but she said it so seriously that I nodded.*

lunch_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_1.text: *I follow Yuna's back into the library. Almost no one comes here during lunch, it seems.*

lunch_yuna_2.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_2.text: *Yuna takes a seat in the corner of the reading room. Opens a book. I'm not sure if she knows I followed her.*

lunch_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_7.text: *without looking up from her book* ...As long as you're quiet.

lunch_yuna_8.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_8.text: *Is that permission? It seems like permission. — Conditional permission.*

lunch_yuna_9.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_9.text: *Silence flows. Yuna reads her book. I have nothing to do, so I browse the shelves.*

lunch_yuna_10.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10.text: *Strange time. Sitting in the library during lunch without saying a word — and yet it's not uncomfortable. Why?*

lunch_yuna_11.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_11.text: *I pick a random book from the shelf and open it.*

lunch_yuna_15.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_15.text: *She slides a book from beside her toward me.*

lunch_yuna_18.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_18.text: *Her sentences are short. But not cold — more like she's being economical with words. Packing the most meaning into the fewest words.*

lunch_yuna_19.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_19.text: *I read for a while. It's actually pretty good.*

lunch_yuna_22.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_22.text: *sliding in a bookmark* ...Thanks for being quiet.

lunch_yuna_25.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_25.text: *Yuna stands up first and walks away. She doesn't look back.*

lunch_yuna_26.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_26.text: *'It was nice.' — Yuna's sentences are short. But those two words linger for a long time.*

lunch_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_freetalk.text: *Sitting side by side with Seoyeon on the rooftop. The breeze feels nice.*
lunch_seo_freetalk.context: First day lunch, just finished eating Seoyeon's homemade bento on the rooftop. Still getting to know each other. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
lunch_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool-beauty student council president. Composed, witty, and direct. Shows interest through actions, not words.

lunch_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
lunch_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting on a bench with Dain at the school store, eating bread.*
lunch_dain_freetalk.context: First day lunch, just had a rock-paper-scissors bet with Dain at the store. She lost and bought bread. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
lunch_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete type. Loves physical contact, uses lots of exclamation marks. Tough outside, soft inside.

lunch_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_freetalk.text: *Reading books side by side with Yuna in the library. It's quiet, but comfortable.*
lunch_yuna_freetalk.context: First day lunch, just spent time with Yuna in the library. The quiet was nice. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
lunch_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Short, dry sentences, but when she opens up, her sentences get longer. Communicates through notes.

lunch_seo_1_aff_high.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1_aff_high.text: Sit here. That thing you said in the hallway earlier — it was kind of funny.

lunch_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_choice.text: *I notice the book Yuna is reading.*
choices: Is that book any good? Maybe I should read it too.

lunch_yuna_c1_1.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_1.text: ...This one? It's pretty good. Want me to lend it to you?

lunch_yuna_c1_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_2.text: ...Let's talk about it when you finish. I'm curious what you think.

lunch_yuna_c2_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c2_2.text: ...But this library isn't bad. It's quiet.

lunch_start_4_ins.name: {name}
lunch_start_4_ins.text: *Dain grabs my arm from beside me.*

lunch_seo_6_ins.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_6_ins.text: *Smiling* Suspicious, aren't you. I just like the breeze up here.

lunch_seo_c1_2_ins.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_2_ins.text: *Seoyeon turns her head slightly. Her ears are red.*

lunch_seo_c1_3_ins.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_3_ins.text: *Those red ears — was that real? — Maybe it's just the wind.*

lunch_seo_after_7_ins.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_7_ins.text: *Dain drags me by the arm to the snack bar. This girl's strength is no joke.*

lunch_dain_12_ins.name: Dain
lunch_dain_12_ins.text: Ughhh fine!! Two soboro buns!! Ma'am!!

lunch_yuna_10_ins.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10_ins.text: *Something is tucked into Yuna's desk. An old bookmark. There's writing on it — but I can't quite make it out. Yuna unconsciously rests her hand on top of it. Something precious, maybe.*
